name: circles-ep02-susu
script_changes: Scene 1 VO: 'One word from Ghana: susu. It means little by little.' -> 'One word from West Africa: susu. In Ghana's Twi, it means little by little.' The Caribbean susu is widely traced to the Yoruba esusu (Bascom 1952; the site's /learn/esusu), so opening on Ghana and then saying 'it crossed the Atlantic' credited the crossing to the wrong people. The Twi meaning stays, attributed to Twi (Ghanaian national press: MyJoyOnline).
Pronunciation guide: Trinidad is TRIN-ih-dad (stress on the first syllable), not trin-ih-DAD.
caption_breaks: ' | ' in a scene's vo marks a caption break. The markers are stripped before TTS and Whisper QA.

voice.direction: Deep, warm documentary voice. Measured, unhurried pace, around 130 words per minute. Confident but never hypey. Think heritage documentary trailer, not a commercial. Minimal processing, natural room tone.
voice.pronunciation: susu = SOO-soo; Twi = chwee; Trinidad = TRIN-ih-dad; ajo = ah-JAW (the Yoruba word)
voice.whisper_hint: Susu. Twi. Ghana. Trinidad. Brooklyn. Ajo. Circles of the World.

scenes.vo: One word from West Africa: | susu. | In Ghana's Twi, | it means little by little. | A plan built | from small pieces.

scenes.headline: It crossed the *ocean.*
scenes.vo: It crossed the Atlantic centuries ago, | and it never died. | Trinidad. | Brooklyn. | Anywhere the diaspora gathers.
scenes.delivery: weight, history, a slight lift on "never died"

scenes.headline: *Everyone* pays in.
scenes.vo: It works like this. | Everyone pays in.

scenes.headline: One takes *the hand.*
scenes.vo: One person takes the whole hand.

scenes.headline: It goes *round.*
scenes.vo: Then it goes round, | until every member | has had a turn.
In Trinidad, | a banker lady collects | from her neighbors every week. | When your turn comes, | the whole hand is yours at once. | No bank. | No paperwork. | Just trust.
scenes.delivery: warm, human, unhurried; this is the heart of the film

scenes.headline:
*The catch:*
someone holds the hand.
scenes.vo: One catch. | Someone has to hold the hand. | And when the circle | stretches across oceans, | trust has further to travel.
scenes.delivery: tension, slow down on the last line

scenes.headline: *Nobody* holds the hand.
scenes.vo: We kept the circle | and removed that one risk. | Same susu, | one new rule: | nobody holds the hand. | It runs on rules | nobody can quietly break.
scenes.delivery: confident lift, peak conviction on "nobody holds the hand"

scenes.vo: Circles of the World. Next week: the ajo. Link in bio to start your circle.
